title: Food-market resilience under conflict, climate, and financial shocks
discussion_signal: FAO’s post frames food-market resilience as a question of how conflict, extreme weather, pandemics, financial crises, and trade disruptions transmit through markets into food-security risk. Replies reinforce the shift from just-in-time to shock-resilient supply chains.
linked_research_question: How do interconnected food markets transmit geopolitical, climate, and financial shocks into food security?
limits: Institutional dissemination is not an independent evaluation
Market resilience does not imply household food security
